key_decisions: DO NOT RE-RUN THE FULL MATRIX. The user rejected it explicitly: re-renting 34 green ops to retest one is waste. The three-step plan exists because of that call.

THE CLAIM THAT A --models RUN TRIPS THE COVERAGE CHECK IS FALSE. It was carried in the previous handoff and repeated once here before being checked. release-health-check.mjs:477 says 'Coverage is REPORTED, never gated - scoping a run is a legitimate call'. The only hard gates are engine.got === pinned, counts.fail > 0, and staleness. Do not resurrect the old claim.

THE REAL DEFECT IS THE OVERWRITE. smoke-evidence.json is a whole-run snapshot, so --models minimax-h3 today would leave a file reading '2 pass, 0 fail, SCOPED' that PASSES release:check - worse than failing, because 1.4 would ship a bumped engine on two proven ops with the record of the other 33 destroyed.

minimax-h3/t2v_ms IS NOT A MODEL BUG. It PASSED at 216s last session and its sibling i2v_ms passed at 132s in this very run. The caller is narrowed to the RENDERER by elimination: wrapper.py ComfyManager.restart() has exactly ONE caller (POST /wrapper/restart-comfy, wrapper.py:907) and _supervise answers an unexpected ComfyUI exit with os._exit(1) which would have taken the container down - the Pod lived and three ops passed after. The server-side caller routes/remoteModels.js:862 is excluded by app.log 03:00:59 'universal nodes: 7/7 already on volume' (it only fires when out.installed is non-empty). So it came through /proxy/restart-comfy: comfyController.js:543 or navigation.js:268.

THE RENDERER WAS LIVE ON THE ENGINE PATH THROUGHOUT THE RUN - its own commandExecutor.js:519 was POSTing /remote/hot-store/ensure and taking 409s. Until MPI-501 is fixed, a matrix needs the app left alone.
app.log is SILENT for the whole GPU leg (stopped 03:00:59 while the run went to 03:27Z). The app logs nothing for a successful proxy hop. Do not read that silence as evidence of anything.

No changelog entry is owed for the crop fix. docs/releases/UNRELEASED.md already carries MPI-498's 'The NVIDIA PiD upscaler now actually upscales' under ## fixes. The crop's effect was never visible to a released user - the missing upscale_method meant the op never executed at all - so a separate line would describe a delta nobody could perceive.
